description: This PHP source file renders the LAN Ethernet configuration page for a network gateway web interface. It includes functions and code to display Ethernet port status, handle user interactions for port configurations (like associating port 2 with specific networks), and dynamically generate content based on device parameters.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether Port 4 is enabled for XH S (Home Security) based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Returns the display name or status for a given Ethernet port based on device operational parameters.
